description: This file contains a test class 'GoldenPathLeaseProviderTestRunner' that implements various unit tests for the 'ILeaseProvider' interface, verifying lease acquisition, release, renewal, and lifecycle behaviors using Xunit framework.

classes.name: GoldenPathLeaseProviderTestRunner
classes.description: A test runner class for testing lease provider functionalities such as acquire, release, renew, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: ProviderCanAcquireLeases
methods.description: Tests if the lease provider can successfully acquire leases for a set of lease requests.

methods.name: ProviderCanReleaseLeases
methods.description: Tests if the lease provider can successfully release acquired leases.

methods.name: ProviderCanRenewLeases
methods.description: Tests if the lease provider can successfully renew leases.

methods.name: Provider_TryAcquireLeaseWhichBelongToOtherEntity_Return_LeaseNotAvailable
methods.description: Tests that acquiring a lease on a resource already leased by another entity results in a 'LeaseNotAvailable' response.

methods.name: Provider_TryRenewLeaseWithWrongToken_Return_InvalidToken
methods.description: Tests that renewing a lease with an invalid token results in an 'InvalidToken' response.

methods.name: Provider_LifeCycle_Acqurie_Renew_Release_ShouldBeAbleToAcquireLeaseOnTheSameResourceAfterRelease
methods.description: Verifies that after releasing a lease, the same resource can be leased again with a different token, confirming proper lifecycle management.
